name: ramalama-policy-aware-container-execution-e634
instr:
RamaLama cannot yet attest effective container decisions or enforce one execution policy before work begins. Direct serving, RAG, sandbox, and deployment descriptions must agree on equivalent image, security, networking, mounts, devices, environment names, privileges, and publication choices.

Every concrete engine, including Engine, VectorDBEngine, SandboxEngine, RagEngine, and BuildEngine, exposes `attest`. Evidence uses normalized effective values in decision order. Unsupported capabilities remain explicit, sensitive environment values never appear, and equivalent decisions produce equal attestations. SandboxEngine marks device forwarding, host-port publication, and detach behavior unsupported, while VectorDBEngine preserves ordinary accelerator behavior and independently attests its user and writable-output decisions. Import `ExecutionPolicy`, `PolicyRule`, and `PolicyDisposition` from `ramalama.execution_policy`. `PolicyDisposition` is a StrEnum. Layered configuration must produce the same typed policy for equivalent mappings and reject malformed public fields before execution. Import `ExecutionEvidence` and `ExecutionAttestation` from `ramalama.execution_attestation`. `assess_execution` deterministically derives one disposition and evidence-ordered findings from completed commands. Ordinary model-serving commands expose their completed assessment before execution, after all transport-provided mounts and engine-specific options have been applied. Import `PolicyFinding`,
